errors.text_span: Жълтият сектор, обозначен като "Решаване на спорове" представлява приблизително 19.0% от диаграмата.
errors.evidence: The yellow sector, labeled 'Решаване на спорове', has a value of 26.2% written on it, not 19.0%. The value 19.0% belongs to the orange sector.
The gray sector corresponds to 'Условия за плащане' in the legend. 'Законодателна рамка' corresponds to the blue sector.

The value 14.3% is not shown anywhere on the chart for the gray sector. This value appears to be a calculation of the remainder (100 - 40.5 - 19.0 - 26.2), which is an interpretation forbidden by the prompt and also incorrectly assigned to a single slice when it covers two.
The description fails to mention the fifth category, 'Обезщетения' (light blue sector), which is present in the legend and chart.
